name: Gale Reef
description: Drift along the walls of Gale Reef, where fan corals and soft corals fill the water with color. This trip suits new and experienced divers, with guided morning dives and relaxed afternoons on the beach.

name: Dawson's Reef
description: A full week at Dawson's Reef, known for its schools of tropical fish and clear water. Includes six guided dives, an introduction to underwater photography, and a sunset boat ride.

name: Claire's Reef
description: A short getaway to Claire's Reef with calm, shallow dives that are ideal for beginners. Snorkeling gear and a certified guide are included with every booking.

name: Gale Reef
description: Our extended Gale Reef trip adds two night dives and a day excursion to the outer reef. Best for divers who want more time in the water and a slower pace on land.

name: Dawson's Reef
description: Spring departure to Dawson's Reef, timed for the best visibility of the season. Includes four guided dives, all meals at the resort, and airport transfers.

name: Claire's Reef
description: Six nights at Claire's Reef with a mix of reef dives and a kayak tour of the mangroves. A good choice for groups and families who want both adventure and downtime.
